remarks: This turnkey ranch, perfectly nestled on 2.85 acres in North Stamford, offers unparalleled privacy and direct lakefront views. Lovingly maintained and thoughtfully upgraded, this 4-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom home is the ideal retreat. The spacious living room, with its cozy wood-burning fireplace and stunning Red Oak hardwood floors, exudes warmth and welcome. French doors open into a sun-drenched sunroom with cathedral ceilings, offering panoramic views of the serene property and lake. A chef's dream, the kitchen boasts granite countertops, a center island, and stainless steel appliances. With ample cabinet space and an abundance of natural light, this kitchen seamlessly blends functionality with elegance. Adjacent to the kitchen is the expansive family room, complete with a striking stone wood-burning fireplace, wet bar, and sliders that lead to a stone terrace-perfect for entertaining. The primary bedroom is a luxurious escape, featuring a full bath with a jet tub, marble countertops, and a separate shower. Two additional generously sized bedrooms, both with hardwood floors, and ample closet space. The home also includes a versatile den, ideal as a home office or guest room, complete with a walk-in cedar closet. The exterior is equally impressive, featuring a well-maintained landscape, an attached garage, and a private driveway. Enjoy year-round comfort with central air and a new heating system.
